correctness.rationale: Width W(u)=a|u1|+b|u2|+c|u3|. Each Haar column is spherical: E|Oij|=1/2, E Oij²=1/3, same row/column absolute cross moment 2/(3pi). For distinct row and column, condition on the first column u and circle perpendicular to it to get E|O11 O22|=(4/pi²)E(1-u2²)=8/(3pi²). Sum weighted entries and subtract (s/2)² to obtain exact V and covariance C. Exchangeability gives Var(orth mean)=(V+2C)/3 and Var(iid mean)=V/3. R(r)=1+2(Ar-B)/(C0+D0 r), r=s²/q in (1,3]; numerator of derivative 2(AC0+BD0)>0, giving sharp upper at cube r=3 and unattained needle infimum r→1. Threshold B/A lies in (1,3); for (1,1,t), two stated positive roots. Verified pinned mathematical derivation and code; independently checked derivative symbolically and covariance for three seeded Haar samples of 80k matrices, finite simulation not general proof.
